ledger.x: Late 17th century: Imam Omar founds the Hiraab Imamate at Mogadishu.
By 1700: the Hiraab hold Galguduud, Mudug and the Shabelle valley.
7 January 1889: the Imamate ends at the first Somali-Italian treaty.

wars.name: French incursion at Mogadishu
wars.outcome: The Imamate repelled a French incursion at Mogadishu in 1701; in 1707 a British naval boat sent ashore was detained.

wars.name: Omani bombardment of Mogadishu
wars.outcome: Oman bombed Mogadishu's port in 1828 (described as British-sponsored); no land changed hands.
